QuestInfo.name: Borrowing Sera's Mirror
QuestInfo.0: What is this place? Try asking #b#p9201191##k.
QuestInfo.1: You met #p9201214#, who is worried about getting a sunburn. She thinks you're a new Explorer! Get the mirror from #b#p9201213##k and bring it to #p9201214#.
QuestInfo.2: You've gone to meet #p9201213# after #p9201214# asked to borrow her mirror. This is just like being a new Explorer!

0.0: You must be new! Adventuring is tough, isn't it? I'll fill you in on what to do, so listen up. #bDouble-click#k on people like me to talk. Press the #bleft and right keys#k to move. You can jump by pressing the #bleft alt key#k.\n\n#b(Do you really look like a newbie? This feels strange... Maple Island feels familiar, but wrong.)
0.1: You can jump diagonally by pressing jump with a direction key. And sometimes you have to climb ropes or ladders to get around. #bPress the up key#k to climb.
0.2: By the way, the sun's really burning me up! Would you mind borrowing a #bmirror#k from #b#p9201213##k for me? I want to see how bad I'm burned.
0.3: Press the #bQuest Notifier#k after opening the #bQuest Window#k by pressing #bQ#k to check your quest progress.

yes.0: Thanks! #b#p9201213##k is on the hill doing her laundry. Her mirror looks like this: #i4031003#.\n\nOh, yeah! Just press #bQ#k if you forget what you're doing and need a reminder.
yes.1: I'm going to lose my voice if I have to keep explaining everything to every Explorer who wanders by... Oh, you're still here? Oops!

no.0: You're not going to help me out? Even after I explained everything to you? Jerk!

npc.0: Haven't met with #r#p9201213##k yet? She should be down a hill to the east. It shouldn't be hard to find her.
